label: Observed value
meaning: Value reported by the source for the season

label: Genuine observed zero
meaning: The source reports zero events; the stored value is 0

label: Observed via fallback
meaning: Value taken from the season leaderboard because the player stats page lacked it

label: Observed, revised by source
meaning: Value differs between collection passes; the later source value is kept (RS5-13)

label: Unavailable observation
meaning: The source provides no value for this player-season; the stored value is null

label: Not applicable or unverified by position
meaning: Position-specific metric on a row whose position does not match or is not verified; null

label: Unsupported metric
meaning: The source has no data for this metric at all (key_passes); null

label: Conflicting source values
meaning: Collection passes disagree and no value could be confirmed; null
